h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagaland

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagaland

items.pText: Children in Nagaland's hill towns often have one shared ground for play, sport and community events, so a playground here has to be compact, sturdy and placed with care. FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, village and town councils, government quarters and parks in Kohima, Dimapur, Mokokchung, Wokha and other district towns.

Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, using galvanised steel, roto-moulded plastic and, in some ranges, wood and composite panels. We dispatch by road, and our installation team or a local dealer fixes the equipment on your site, self-standing or grouted depending on the ground. You can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, which helps when a school wants its playground to match its uniform or building colours. Send the site size, a few photos and the age group, and we will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Keeping a hill playground in good shape

c: Upkeep matters more in the hills than in the plains. Heavy monsoon rain carries mud and leaves onto play areas, and cool, damp air slows drying. After each monsoon, tighten bolts, check swing hangers and clear soil from around the bases. Wash roto-moulded slides and panels with plain water so moss does not settle on them.

items.q: Can we choose playground colours to match our school?
items.a: Yes. Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 colour shades. Tell us the colours you want when you share the site details, and we will show them on the drawing and in the quote.

items.q: What upkeep does playground equipment need after the monsoon?
items.a: Tighten bolts, check swing hangers and chains, clear mud and leaves from the bases and wash plastic parts with water. Report any worn part to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.

items.q: Is the warranty the same for hill districts?
items.a: Yes. It is 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, provided installation and upkeep follow our instructions.
